reviews.text: I love seeing Meg, and my husband has been seeing Chris for years. They are experts at what they do and maintain a relaxing environment for their clientele. When I come and just describe a vibe I’m looking for with my hair, Meg gets it spot on each time.
Chris does an amazing job every time. He listens, makes sure you get exactly what you want, and is very meticulous. I'm very particular about my hair and I can't recommend Chris and Jackalope enough!
Had the best experience getting my hair done. Lisa works miracles and I absolutely love my hair for the first time in many years. I finally found my hair stylist.
